description: Rewards whoever Server Boosts {guild}, and takes it back automatically when the boost ends.

revoke.title: Revoke all rewards
revoke.description: Takes back from everyone what the module granted. It's a separate action on purpose: {emphasis}, it freezes the state, and that's the path you can undo.
revoke.descriptionEmphasis: turning off the module revokes nothing
revoke.confirmDescription: Everyone loses the role and the in-game removal action fires for each person. Only use this if you really want to reset the module. Turning off the module does NOT do this, and it's the reversible path.
revoke.success: {count, plural, one {# reward being revoked.} other {# rewards being revoked.}}

overview.sweepLast: Last run {minutes} min ago, with {count, plural, one {# booster} other {# boosters}}.
overview.sweepStaleHint: The bot may be offline; boost state isn't being reconciled.
overview.sweepNever: It hasn't run yet. It starts a few minutes after the bot comes up.
overview.enabledHint: Turning it off freezes everything; it does {not} revoke anyone's rewards. There's an action in Tools for that.
overview.graceHint: 0 revokes as soon as the boost drops. A small value (5 to 30) absorbs a boost that expires and is renewed right after, without taking the car away and giving it back.
overview.revokeOnLeave: Revoke when the member leaves the server
overview.revokeOnLeaveHint: The role leaves with them anyway; this decides whether the {ingame} reward is also taken back.
overview.ttlHint: How long the command waits for the player to join the game server. The 24h default exists for a reason: with a short window, the {removal} for someone who stopped boosting while offline expires before they come back, and the item never goes away.

boosters.problemsHint: Deliveries that ran out of attempts. The most common cause is the bot lacking permission to manage roles, or the reward role sitting above the bot's role.
boosters.empty: When someone boosts, the record shows up here, including people who have stopped.
boosters.totalDays: {count, plural, one {# day in total} other {# days in total}}

rewards.created: Reward created. It applies to whoever boosts from now on.
rewards.deleteDescription: Anyone who already received it will LOSE what was granted: the role is removed and the in-game removal action fires. This can't be undone.
rewards.deletedWithGrants: {count, plural, one {Reward deleted; # grant being revoked.} other {Reward deleted; # grants being revoked.}}
rewards.backfillDescription: Everyone already boosting gets this reward now. For an in-game action this fires one command per person at once, so check the setup first.
rewards.backfillDone: {granted, plural, one {# grant} other {# grants}} across {boosters, plural, one {# booster} other {# boosters}}.
rewards.noRetroactive: A new reward is {not} retroactive: use "Apply to current boosters" after checking the setup.
rewards.empty: No rewards yet. Without them, boosting delivers nothing.
rewards.lockIngame: {feature} (give a car, money, an item, and take it back when the boost drops) requires the Pro plan, the same unlock as the FiveM/MTA module.
